% Bar legend images (behaviour Z14, found by the generator fuzz): `xbar` draws
% two horizontal bars (0.8em at -0.2em, 0.6em at 2*3pt-0.2em); the stacked
% styles draw the single-bar images.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[xbar, legend pos=south east]
\addplot coordinates {(2,1) (3,2)};
\addlegendentry{left}
\addplot coordinates {(1.5,1) (2.5,2)};
\addlegendentry{right}
\end{axis}
\begin{axis}[at={(7cm,0)}, ybar stacked, legend pos=north west]
\addplot coordinates {(1,2) (2,3)};
\addlegendentry{base}
\addplot coordinates {(1,1) (2,2)};
\addlegendentry{top}
\end{axis}
\begin{axis}[at={(0,-6cm)}, xbar stacked, legend pos=south east]
\addplot coordinates {(2,1) (3,2)};
\addlegendentry{a}
\addplot coordinates {(1,1) (1,2)};
\addlegendentry{b}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
